english.title: Use a record sheet / drivers card in recording equipment for a period longer than authorised
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used a

(A)_[record sheet]_
(B)_[drivers card]_

in recording equipment installed in accordance with the Community Recording Equipment Regulation in a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to which section 97 of the Transport Act 1968 applied, for a period longer than that which was authorised by Articles 13 and 15 of those regulations, namely **(..SPECIFY THE EXCESS PERIOD..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 97(1)(a)(iii) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) Where the place of offence is uncertain, see section 103(7) of the Act, which provides that an offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
(ii) Section 97(7) defines the "Community Recording Equipment Regulation" as Council Regulation (EEC ) No. 561/06, as amended.
(iii) Each breach may be charged separately if this is appropriate to the facts of the case.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed Penalty Ticket - fifty pounds

6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
